name: adswipefile
description: Winning Facebook and Instagram ads, competitor ads, hooks and angles from the AdSwipeFile ad library, in your AI agent over MCP: search real Meta ads by brand, niche and format, see what a brand is running, read an ad's copy and audiences, and write hooks from real ads, each linked to the ad's page.

interface.shortDescription: Ad library of winning Meta ads
interface.longDescription:
AdSwipeFile is an ad library of winning Facebook and Instagram ads for people who make Meta ads: media buyers, creative strategists, freelancers, agencies and DTC brands. Real ads from real brands, filed by brand, niche and format, that your AI assistant searches for you instead of you scrolling the Meta Ad Library.

Ask what ads a competitor is running and get the formats, hooks, angles and offers it repeats. Ask for winning ads in a niche such as skincare, supplements or software, or in a format such as UGC, before and after, testimonial or comparison. Open an ad to read its audiences and, where your account includes it, its copy, then have the assistant name its hook and angle and write hooks for your product in the same pattern. Ads tracked on Meta show when they started and how long they have run. Check the ads you saved on adswipefile.com, and the newest ads of the brands you follow there.

Every ad links to its page on adswipefile.com, where you can see the creative.

What it does not do: "winning" means ads brands kept running and that the library filed as worth studying. The library holds no spend, reach or performance data, so it never says how an ad performed or that one ad beat another. It does not cover every brand or every ad and is not a live feed of the Meta Ad Library. It cannot run, buy or edit ads, and does not generate images or video. Every tool is read-only. An AdSwipeFile account is required to connect.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0: Listing, skills and example prompts rewritten in the words ad buyers use: winning ads, competitor ads, hooks and angles. Two skills are renamed: find-ad-examples is now find-winning-ads and brand-teardown is now competitor-ads, so commands that named the old skills need the new names. Search winning Facebook and Instagram ads by brand, niche and format; see what ads a brand is running; read an ad's copy, audiences and run dates; review your saved ads and the new ads of brands you follow. Eight read-only tools, every ad linked to its page.
